concept: 安娜斯塔西亚杀的定义
question_cn: 什么是安娜斯塔西亚杀（Anastasia's Mate）？

options.text_cn: 两个象从对角线交叉将死角落的王
options.text_en: Two bishops checkmate a cornered king along crossing diagonals

options.text_cn: 双车并列将死底线的王
options.text_en: Two rooks line up to checkmate the king on the back rank

options.text_cn: 车和马配合，将王困在边线，马封住内侧逃格，车沿边线将死
options.text_en: A rook and knight trap the king on the edge: the knight covers the inward escape squares while the rook mates along the edge

options.text_cn: 后在对角线将死被己方棋子封住的王
options.text_en: A queen checkmates a king trapped by its own pieces along a diagonal

explanation_cn: 安娜斯塔西亚杀的核心特征：王被困在边线（h线或a线），马封住王的内侧逃格，车沿边线发动将死。兵或己方棋子通常协助封住其余逃格。
explanation_en: Anastasia's mate traps the king on an edge file, usually the a- or h-file. The knight covers the king's inward escape squares while the rook delivers mate along the edge; pawns or other friendly pieces often block the remaining exits.
